from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        bg_a = Counter(x for row in a for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        bg_b = Counter(x for row in b for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[2 if x != bg_a and y != bg_b else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    sep_col = next(c for c in range(w) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
    b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(sep_col, w - sep_col - 1)
    bg_a = Counter(x for row in a for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg_b = Counter(x for row in b for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[2 if a[r][c] != bg_a and b[r][c] != bg_b else 0 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
